authenticity.evidence: Natural Australian: "The first auction's done and dusted", "No one can tell you what the market price will do down the track", "Have a read of the full FOLD Auction Terms". "It's for folks who had a go" uses American "folks".

register.evidence: A friendly level-3 retelling throughout, light on the dense technical bits ("Participants put their bids in through the official Uniswap CCA interface"), no swearing, fine for an FAQ at dad level.

tone.evidence: Stays an informative FAQ; safety warnings keep their weight ("Interfold team members and moderators will never, ever ask for your seed phrase"). Paraphrasing the legal notices relaxes their formal register a little.

flow.evidence: Reads smoothly: "The CCA hands out tokens bit by bit and uses the one price for everyone within each period."
